title: Be a registered land surveyor
what: Carry out land surveys (or mining surveys) for fee or reward only as a registered surveyor.

sources.title: Surveying and Spatial Information Act 2002 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry out a land survey for fee or reward, or (b) advertise that he or she is willing to carry out a land survey for fee or reward, unless the person is a registered land surveyor

administration.who: Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (NSW)

sources.title: Surveying and Spatial Information Act 2002 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 3, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Board means the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information constituted by section 27.
